name: handdraw-style-prompter
title_zh: 编号 001–216 手绘风格，报号即出双语提示词
tagline_zh: 不用描述风格，报个编号就有双语提示词。还能判断当前模型要不要配参考图，省得你瞎试。
tagline_en: Just cite a number from 001–216, get bilingual prompts. It also tells you if your model needs the style reference.
desc_en: Turn a 001–216 hand-drawn style number and image theme into bilingual prompts, or generate an image with a model-capability-aware decision about whether the matching numbered image is needed as a style reference.
why_zh: 把风格库变成可检索的编号系统，提示词生成前先做模型能力判断，避免参考图成了干扰。
why_en: Turns a style library into a searchable numbering system, and checks model capability before prompting—so a reference image.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 001–216 这 216 种手绘风格；提示词是通用双语模板，不针对特定模型微调；若模型本身支持风格模仿。
limit_en: Covers only styles 001–216; prompts are generic bilingual templates, not model-tuned; if your model already mimics styles well, the reference image.
title_en: Hand-drawn style #001–216: number in, bilingual prompt out
